scope_decision.rationale: Selected the work that unblocks the most downstream work. Discovery-execution pipeline is the dominant emergence blocker (FFMx E component depth is suppressed because chains die at depth 1). FFMx gate and schema v2 fold cleanly into the same artifact because they touch the same surfaces (manifest fields + spawn-time decisions). The deferred items need their own focused architecture passes.

prescan_decision: passed — no prior wire-discovery-execution-pipeline artifact in forensics/artifacts/2026-04-28/; primary deliverable is greenfield
key_findings: Empirical: 0/80+ discovered_work items have ever been re-spawned across 51 W1 manifests. 0% exec rate confirmed.
Root cause: 4 gaps — no promotion script, no claim ledger, no prescan gate for discoveries, no wave-aware routing of bearings.
Solution: 5-stage pipeline (Harvest → Dedupe → Prescan → Wave-Route → Bundle Emit) implemented as scripts/9x_discovery_promoter.py.
FFMx gate placed at Stage 4 with 1.3x baseline forecast threshold (lower than 1.5x publish threshold; spawn-time forecasts are noisier than measured outcomes).
Manifest Schema v2 is additive and fail-open; backward-compatible with all existing manifests; 12 new fields covering lineage, time-tracking, and FFMx forecast/post.
Bearing→Wave mapping: N→W1 (scouts unblock), S→W2 (fixers proceed), E→W2 (parallel batch), W→W3 (synthesizers reframe).
Hook wiring: post-handoff hook + 30-min cron for reliability. No new abstraction; just wires existing scripts to existing events.
Equilibrium plan: 7-day shadow mode in --dry-run, measure FFMx delta, only promote if exec rate ≥0.60 AND FFMx ≥1.3x baseline.

architectural_decisions.decision: Discovery promoter is a separate script (9x tier), not a hook into existing /run
architectural_decisions.rationale: Separation of concerns — /run consumes bundles; promoter produces bundles. Mixing them would couple discovery to claim cycle.
architectural_decisions.tradeoff: One more script to maintain; one more cron entry. Acceptable because the script is small (~150 LOC) and the contract is narrow.

architectural_decisions.rationale: 1.5x is the FGR threshold for measured improvements. Forecasts are noisier; gating at 1.5x would over-reject. 1.3x = positive expected value with margin.
architectural_decisions.tradeoff: Will allow some marginal promotions through. Mitigation: shadow-mode measurement for 30 days, tune constant based on outcomes.

architectural_decisions.decision: Schema v2 changes are all additive and fail-open
architectural_decisions.rationale: Mutation discipline: don't break existing manifests; let validator emit warnings instead of errors. Allows gradual migration as agents learn.
architectural_decisions.tradeoff: Required-marked fields aren't actually enforced for first sprint. Acceptable because schema validator counts violations and enables data-driven enforcement decision.

architectural_decisions.decision: Claim ledger is JSONL append-only, not a database
architectural_decisions.rationale: Forensic integrity (hash-chain compatible). No service to run. Trivially backed up by the same git/S3 path as the rest of forensics.
architectural_decisions.tradeoff: Linear scan on dedupe (O(N) per harvest). Mitigated: ledger is small (1 line per claim, ~200 bytes); 10K claims = 2MB scan; <50ms.
